subject: Azure private plan — entitlement matrix & export control confirmation
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novacare.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure private plan — entitlement matrix & export control confirmation

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Were moving toward a private plan purchase with Redwood for Novacares internal clinical summarization workload and need to lock a few items before procurement can issue a PO: 

1) Entitlement matrix: mapping of the private-plan SKUs (per-seat / per-token tiers) to the Azure meter IDs well need on our side for invoicing and entitlement. Can you share the CSV mapping and an example invoice line?

2) Export controls / restricted data: Novacare has EU patients and we need explicit language that model weights and underlying raw telemetry are not exported outside customer-specified regions. Please confirm whether Redwoods private plan supports region-pinning for inference and any export-control clause you typically accept.

3) SLA & termination: procurement asks for a 30-day termination notice and clarity on availability credits for private plan (were targeting 99.9% monthly).

4) Audit evidence: SOC 2 attestation and a short list of logs/audit artifacts available (audit log retention, redaction controls).

Ive attached our standard procurement form for your reference (NC_Procurement_Form_0826.xlsx). If easier, happy to schedule a 30-minute call with our legal/procurement teams.

Thanks,
Evan Brooks
Procurement Manager
Novacare Health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@novacare.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure private plan — entitlement matrix & export control confirmation

Hi Evan,

Appreciate the clear list. Ill get you the entitlement matrix and invoice example by EOD tomorrow. Looping in Kimberly (legal) for export-control language and Marissa (partner ops) for entitlement mapping and onboarding timeline.

Quick answers up front:
- Region pinning: supported in Private (VPC) deployments; we can bind inference to Azure regions and restrict cross-region replication for customer-owned data. Ill ask legal to share recommended contract language.
- SLA: our Dedicated/Private plans have configurable SLA targets; 99.9% is supported for enterprise SKUs — legal will confirm exact credit mechanics.

Marissa, can you export an initial entitlement CSV and a sample invoice line for Novacare?

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
--

Thanks for the ping, Rachel.

High level from legal:
- Export-control clause: we propose the following minimal language for the private plan addendum: "Customer data and derivative artifacts produced by the service shall not be exported outside the region(s) specified in Schedule A; Redwood will not transfer model checkpoints or customer telemetry to third-party jurisdictions except as required by law." Ive attached a short doc with the clause marked up (redline_export_clause.docx).
- Data residency vs model weights: we can commit to inference execution in customer-selected Azure regions and to restricting backups/snapshots containing customer telemetry. However, model weights for the inference engine (open models we ship) are maintained by Redwood; we can provide an attest that we do not inject customer telemetry into base model training or external model repos.
- Audit access: were comfortable agreeing to on-site or remote audit with reasonable notice; need to confirm the standard NDA scope for any PII access.

Questions for Novacare: do you require contract-level export controls (i.e., specific regulatory citations), or is a mutual-representations clause sufficient?

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
